notes: Semantic layer for this pack. Lives beside the pack rather than inside index.json so --reindex never discards it. Mechanical tags (filename tokens, pack name) are derived at reindex time and must not be duplicated here.

shapes/blob-organic.svg.description: Irregular organic blob for a soft colored backdrop behind type or a card.

shapes/blob-soft.svg.description: Rounder, calmer blob; reads as a deliberate shape rather than a splash.

shapes/wave-divider.svg.description: Single-crest wave for a section edge or a scene-to-scene seam.

shapes/wave-layered.svg.description: Two offset wave layers; animate at different speeds for parallax depth.

shapes/grid-dots.svg.description: Dot matrix backdrop. Tiles seamlessly at 20-unit pitch.

shapes/grid-lines.svg.description: Hairline graph grid for a technical or blueprint register. Tiles at 20-unit pitch.

shapes/arrow-curve.svg.description: Sweeping curved arrow for annotation. Stroke-based, so a draw-on animation works.

shapes/arrow-elbow.svg.description: Right-angle connector arrow for flow and step diagrams.

shapes/burst-star.svg.description: Solid star burst for a badge, a price tag, or a celebratory accent.

shapes/burst-rays.svg.description: Radiating stroke rays. Stagger each ray for a pop-in impact accent.

shapes/frame-bracket.svg.description: Four corner brackets — a viewfinder frame that draws attention without a full border.

shapes/frame-ticket.svg.description: Ticket-stub container with side notches for a label or callout card.

shapes/underline-marker.svg.description: Marker-pen underline for keyword emphasis. Reveal with a left-to-right clip.

shapes/underline-scribble.svg.description: Two-pass scribbled underline for a casual, hand-annotated register.

shapes/counter-ring.svg.description: Progress ring with a track. Animate stroke-dashoffset to count a value up.

shapes/bar-proportional.svg.description: Proportional fill bar with a track — gives a bare number visual presence.
